jobs.title: Front End Developer
jobs.description: Remote Front End Developer About SchemeServe For 26 years, SchemeServe has helped transform insurance products into successful, profitable solutions. We’re always looking for new ways to innovate and improve. We strive to challenge industry norms and bring a unique personality to our work. In a nutshell, SchemeServe is a UK-based Insurance SaaS solution specialising in services for starting, managing, and growing traditional (and specialist) insurance products. It was started in 2000 by our CEO and Founder, Adam, and the software now represents the leading edge in super-fast scheme deployment and truly Obsessive Support ™. We’re fully remote, but we get together twice a year for some not-so-serious, and teeny tiny bit of serious, time together. We value self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and take on new challenges. To help with this, we offer learning budgets for courses, books, and workshops. Since we’re remote, we don’t offer free snacks or bean bags, but we do provide flexible work arrangements, a healthy work-life balance, and a friendly company culture. Every Thursday, we have 'Elevenses,' where anyone can join a video call to catch up, share stories, or play games. It helps us stay connected. About the role Enjoy the freedom of remote work while playing a key role in shaping the tools that thousands of brokers and insurers rely on. By enhancing our front-end, you'll improve user interfaces that empower professionals to manage schemes more efficiently and provide excellent service to their clients, all from the comfort of your home. If you're a passionate Front-end Developer in the UK who knows React.js and modern front-end tools, this opportunity could be an excellent fit for you. We’re looking for someone ready to jump in and focus on building user interfaces as part of one of our product teams. Within 6 to 12 months, you’ll help build and modernise core parts of SchemeServe, significantly enhancing our clients' workflow and efficiency.

jobs.description: Help Us Change the Way the World Works Build something that matters. Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential. About the Role This is a full-time, 12-month program at our Berlin HQ for people who want to understand AI rather than just use it. It begins where our product meets the real world: customer support. Many support tickets are a small puzzle about how large language models and cloud software behave in production. Why did the same prompt give two different answers? Why did a long document get cut off? Why is one model fast today and slow tomorrow? Why did an agent call the wrong tool? Why did an API integration time out? You will be the person who works out what is actually going on and explains it clearly. For most of your first year, the support queue is your home base and your classroom. Few jobs expose you to as many real AI systems, real enterprise environments, and real failure modes, every single day. The purpose of the year: by month twelve, you should understand our platform and operations deeply, from the chat interface down to the models and infrastructure behind it. A Langdock business team should want to hire you permanently, and you should have found the work that energizes you most. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’UFR S2I sur le Campus de Brest. Projet FLOWATT Le projet FLOWATT, dans le cadre duquel s’inscrit cette étude, vise à déployer et exploiter six hydroliennes dans les forts courants marins du Raz Blanchard, en Normandie. Au-delà de la production d’énergie, FLOWATT a pour objectif d’évaluer le potentiel du Raz Blanchard pour le déploiement de fermes hydroliennes à plus grande échelle. Cette évaluation repose notamment sur une caractérisation précise de la ressource, une estimation fine du productible et une meilleure compréhension des impacts environnementaux. Pour répondre à ces enjeux, le projet combine mesures in situ, modélisation numérique et essais expérimentaux afin de fournir les connaissances nécessaires à la préparation des futurs déploiements commerciaux, tout en contribuant à la réduction des coûts de production et à la limitation des impacts sur l’environnement marin. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Bienvenue chez la Maison MGA une entreprise où l’innovation rencontre l’excellence humaine. Rejoindre notre équipe, c’est vivre une aventure professionnelle portée par la bienveillance, le challenge, la progression continue… et une bonne dose de convivialité ! Tu intégreras notre entité MGA MedTech basé à Mably (42) spécialisée dans le développement de solutions technologiques avancées dédiées au secteur médical et des dispositifs médicaux. Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi ? Pour accompagner notre développement, nous recrutons un.e gestionnaire des données techniques ERP pour renforcer nos équipes. Le.a gestionnaire.e des données techniques met en forme le dossier de fabrication des nouveaux produits dans le respect des impératifs de qualité, coûts, délais et HSE. Il.elle est responsable de la création des données produits dans l’ERP et de leur mise à jour dans le cadre de la gestion des modifications, dans le respect des procédures internes. Il.elle participe à la rédaction des livrables nécessaires à la constitution du DMR (Device Master Record) en vue de son transfert de la R&D au Manufacturing en vue de la production en série. Les missions seront les suivantes : Prise en main du dossier R&D / Client Structurer et formaliser les nomenclatures, gammes de fabrication, modes opératoires Tracer les évolutions et mettre à jour les dossiers Gestion des données techniques dans l’ERP Créer, modifier et maintenir les articles, nomenclatures, gammes et données associées dans l’ERP Participer au process de demandes de changement et assurer les mises à jour dans l’ERP Garantir l’application des règles de codification et de gestion documentaire en lien avec le système qualité Identifier les anomalies de données et proposer des actions correctives Assurer la traçabilité des modifications et des validations. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel. Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit. Your own journey is important to us too. The Role_ // At Masabi, we're building technology that makes public transport simpler, fairer and more accessible for millions of people. Behind every agency that runs on our platform is a commercial agreement someone had to shape, negotiate and close. It starts with major tenders and public procurements, where you'll shape our position on the terms we can work with and the ones worth challenging. From there you'll take the deal through negotiation to signature, with colleagues across the business bringing the commercial and technical detail. Underneath runs the advisory side: data protection and privacy, IP and licensing, and the questions that come with operating across several markets. jobs.description: About Boltz Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible. Boltz was founded by former MIT scientists who created Boltz-1, the first fully commercially available open-source model to approach AlphaFold 3-level accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes. jobs.title: Enterprise Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: about us Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world. For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses. AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it. We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture. Check out our principles to see how we work. about the role As Enterprise Deployment Strategist you own deployment and commercial success for a portfolio of telli's largest (tier 1) customers. Drive Specification & Documentation Control: Approve raw material specifications in close collaboration with Product Development and Purchasing, and review critical supplier documentation such as Certificates of Analysis (COAs), Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), and regulatory declarations. Oversee Incoming Quality & Compliance: Manage and continuously optimize the Incoming Inspection process including sampling plans (e.g., AQL) and ensure all materials and processes comply with internal specifications, industry standards (e.g., ISO, GMP), and applicable regulations. Embed Proactive Risk Management: Conduct and participate in risk assessments (such as FMEA) to proactively identify, evaluate, and mitigate quality risks across raw materials and external supplier processes. Fehler sind bei uns Lektionen, keine Schuldfrage. Wir steigen nur ungern zweimal in denselben Fluss. Corporate sind wir nicht. Unzuverlässig allerdings auch nicht. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases. You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation. What You'll Work On Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites. These companies have hundreds of trucks (un)loading every month, and our SaaS platform helps them orchestrate that whole process. jobs.description: Wir sind Digital Beat , wir gestalten Wissensaustausch im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz. An unserem Standort in Köln bringen 15 Mitarbeiter:innen Unternehmen, Selbstständigen und Führungskräften bei, wie sie KI im Arbeitsalltag wirklich einsetzen – mit Lehrgängen, Webinaren und Events. Auf Instagram folgen uns rund 80.000 Menschen, dazu kommen LinkedIn, YouTube und TikTok. Du scrollst nicht nur durch Reels, sondern fragst dich, warum eins hängen bleibt und das andere nicht? Du stehst gern vor der Kamera und schneidest danach selbst? Dann suchen wir dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Social Media & Content Creation mit 20 Stunden pro Woche. Du bist dabei auch selbst vor der Kamera zu sehen und repräsentierst Digital Beat auf unseren Kanälen. KI ist dabei dein tägliches Werkzeug – vom Skript bis zum Schnitt. Du drehst Video-Ads für Meta und weitere Plattformen – mal als Darsteller:in, mal hinter der Kamera für Kolleg:innen. Du entwickelst Skripte, Hooks und Formate selbst – mit KI-Tools für Recherche, Skript, Schnitt, Stimme und Avatare – und setzt sie innerhalb der Strategie um, die wir gemeinsam im Marketing festlegen. Du siehst die Zahlen hinter deinen Videos: Welche Ads verkaufen, welche Reels laufen – und lernst daraus für das nächste. Du behältst Trends und neue Formate im Blick und probierst sie für unsere Kanäle aus. Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du: an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben bist, idealerweise in Medien, Kommunikation, Marketing, Film oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang dich vor der Kamera wohlfühlst, klar sprichst und natürlich wirkst – das ist für diese Stelle Pflicht Videos selbst schneidest, zum Beispiel mit CapCut, Premiere Pro oder vergleichbaren Tools ein Gespür dafür hast,

Deine Rolle Du verbindest Kanzleipraxis, DATEV-Erfahrung und Prozessverständnis mit Interesse an KI und Automatisierung. Du stehst im ständigen Austausch mit unseren Partnerkanzleien, nimmst deren Abläufe auf und entwickelst daraus Standardprozesse für den Verbund. Du musst selbst keine Software entwickeln. Die technische Umsetzung übernimmt unser Entwickler. Entscheidend ist, dass du Kanzleiprozesse fachlich verstehst und Anforderungen so beschreiben kannst, dass daraus funktionierende Lösungen entstehen. Wenn du Lust hast, selbst Automatisierungen zu bauen, zeigen wir dir die Werkzeuge dafür. jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world. Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use. Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next. Why This Role BFL’s research organization is split into different focus areas, such as pre-training, post-training, reinforcement learning, data, representation learning, evaluations and more. During the day to day work, researchers from these different focus areas work together to solve exciting and hard problems towards solving visual intelligence. Having the right means to measure what matters is the central starting point for every research project. Researchers make decisions based on the outcomes of evaluations. The right decision can only be made if an evaluation is precise and accurate. As the Evaluations Lead you’re the core driver to ensure that. Central responsibilities include building our eval roadmap in collaboration with the research and product teams, managing and extending our evaluation team, and cross-functional work with project leads to make sure each research project has the best evaluation toolbox to help the people working on it to make the right decisions. Finally, you’re responsible for growing the people in your team and maintain an eye on their long term development during the daily project work. jobs.description: About Us Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before. We are the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals health than ever. The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe's top 100 AI startups with a team of over 80 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 3M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London. AI is not a side project here. jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobs.description: Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter. Bij Lefebvre Sdu bouwen we al 200 jaar aan die kennis. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Andere legal AI-tools draaien op onze data en software. Als Nederlands hart van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ontwikkelen we bovendien ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, waarop juristen en fiscalisten niet zomaar een antwoord krijgen, maar een antwoord waar ze hun naam onder durven te zetten. Meer dan 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, goed voor ruim 100 miljoen euro ARR in Europa. We zoeken een Senior HR Business Partner die ons team door een verandertraject begeleidt en adviseert. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Lefebvre Sdu transformeert van uitgever naar techbedrijf. Nergens is dat zo voelbaar als in ons product team. De mensen die hier werken bouwen het platform waarop onze AI-revolutie draait, en ze doen dat terwijl de organisatie om hen heen verandert. 70 mensen nu, vacatures open, en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR Adviseur die dit team begeleidt. Niet op afstand, maar als iemand die begrijpt wat er speelt, de juiste vragen stelt en mensen vooruit helpt. Dit ga je doen: Jij bent de HR-partner van het team dat onze transformatie mogelijk maakt. Wat hier speelt is direct voelbaar in de hele organisatie. Je begeleidt managers en medewerkers in het content, tech- en IT-team op alle HR vraagstukken, van instroom tot ontwikkeling. Je signaleert wat er speelt in het team en vertaalt dat naar concrete HR-interventies die werken. Je adviseert managers bij veelvoorkomende thema’s rondom leiderschap, performance en talent development. Je draagt actief bij aan de cultuurverandering die bij deze transformatie hoort. Je werkt nauw samen met je collega HR Adviseurs en de Head of People aan de verdere opbouw van het people team. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent een HR professional die begrijpt hoe tech & product teams werken. Je weet wat er speelt als een organisatie snel groei

jobs.description: Brief info about Vinted  Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we re looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Together we cover finance and operations, including HR and part of legal, across three entities: France, the UK and the US. That means this internship isn't a back-office job: it's a front-row seat. You will be our first Finance & Operations intern, working hand in hand with our Founding FP&A, who you report to directly, on the processes and numbers that keep the company running across three jurisdictions. You'll be expected to roll up your sleeves, get into the detail, and own real work from week one. Nothing here is theoretical. If you want breadth rather than a narrow slice, and you'd rather build processes than inherit them, this is your opportunity. 💪 About your mission Finance operations: Support day-to-day finance: client billing, supplier payments, cash management and financial documents. Planning: Support budgeting and forecasting. People operations: Contribute to the employee lifecycle: onboarding, offboarding, HR documents and employee records. Legal and contracts: Help prepare and track contracts and corporate documents. Be the first answer: Act as the first line of response for the team's day-to-day administrative questions. jobs.title: Technical Pre-sales Solution Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Role Overview As a Technical Pre-sales Solution Engineer (EMS, PPC & SCADA) at NeuVerge-Tron GmbH, you will serve as the technical lead and solution architect during pre-sales and tender phases for utility-scale renewable energy and energy storage power plants. In this position, your core product portfolio comprises Energy Management Systems (EMS), Power Plant Controllers (PPC), and SCADA platforms . You will analyze customer requirements, regional Grid Codes, and Transmission/Distribution System Operator (TSO/DSO) mandates, translating them into resilient, high-availability, and cybersecure system architectures. (Note: This role focuses on control software, industrial automation, and OT system architecture; it does not cover battery cell sizing, containerized mechanical design, or civil EPC scope.) Key Responsibilities Technical Pre-sales & Bid Management Analyze customer technical specifications, RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs for utility-scale solar, wind, and hybrid BESS assets. Author technical proposals, functional architecture diagrams, and Statements of Work (SOW) for EMS/SCADA solutions. Compile compliance matrices and deviation lists addressing customer specifications and utility regulations. jobs.title: Stagiair Journalistiek - Trouw
jobs.description: Wil je graag snel aan de slag in de journalistiek? Dan is deze stage op de redactie bij Trouw iets voor jou. Trouw bereikt dagelijks duizenden betrokken mensen met de verdiepende journalistiek via print en online via de nieuwssite, nieuwsapps en digitale krant. Doordeweeks gaat het om 316.000 lezers via print en op zaterdag om ruim 430.000 lezers via krant en magazine. Daarnaast bereikt Trouw ook nog eens 2,3 miljoen unieke digitale lezers per maand via web en app. Kom bij ons stagelopen en zie je eigen ideeën, verhalen en producties terug in print, op onze site of social media. Wat ga je doen Stagiair zijn bij Trouw betekent hard werken, maar ook zelfstandig meedraaien, veel schrijven en op pad gaan, meewerken aan de online promotie van je verhalen en je ontwikkelen als volwaardig lid van een redactie. Stages zijn mogelijk bij nieuwsredacties verslaggeverij/binnenland, buitenland/nieuwsdienst, sport en politiek maar ook bij de redacties religie & filosofie en duurzaamheid & economie. Trouw zorgt daarbij voor deskundige en intensieve begeleiding. Voor goede stagiaires zijn er ook na de stage ook mogelijkheden voor werk. Veel van onze stagiairs blijven na hun stage aan de redactie verbonden. Trouw vindt een diverse redactie belangrijk en streeft daarom naar een open werksfeer, waar ruimte is voor collega’s met verschillende achtergronden en opvattingen. Profiel Wat we van jou verwachten? Wij zoeken een creatief en journalistiek talent. Je weet wat er in de wereld speelt en vindt het leuk om op nieuws te jagen en mooie verhalen te maken. Je bent iemand die: een journalistieke opleiding volgt op HBO- of WO-niveau; HBO-studenten moeten eerst elders succesvol stage hebben gelopen, WO-studenten moet een master journalistiek volgen; goed kan communiceren; stevig in zijn schoenen staat; onderwerpen tot op de bodem wil uitzoeken; goed de weg weet in social media; foutloos schrijft; creatief bent in het bedenken van onderwerpen. Periode Wij nemen het hele jaar stagiairs aan.

jobs.description: Rotterdam - Als Manager Redactionele Strategie & Analyse ben je een analytisch zwaargewicht en verantwoordelijk voor de strategie en prioritering binnen het cluster. Je realiseert duurzame digitale groei door data-inzichten strategisch te verankeren binnen een specifiek cluster van titels. Je fungeert daarnaast als de onmisbare schakel tussen het centrale RI&G-team en de lokale redacties. Jouw rol focust zich op het Algemeen Dagblad (AD) en 7 regiotitels, zoals De Stentor of De Gelderlander. Wie zijn wij? Wij zijn de afdeling Redactionele inzichten & groei (RI&G). Binnen de divisie Nieuwsmedia & Magazines zijn wij dé strategische partner voor de redacties. We leveren niet zomaar losse adviezen of rapportages aan, maar we realiseren duurzame digitale groei door data-inzichten strategisch te verankeren binnen onze mediatitels. We fungeren als de onmisbare schakel tussen het centrale expertisecentrum en de dagelijkse praktijk op de lokale redacties. Door complexe datasets te vertalen naar een helder, strategisch verhaal, maken we redactionele besluitvorming inzichtelijk en stevig onderbouwd. Zo helpen we de redacties om redactionele en operationele kansen in één oogopslag te signaleren en bepalen we samen de digitale koers van onze nieuwsmerken. Wat ga je doen? Cluster-regie & Prioritering: Je beheert de roadmap voor het gehele cluster en bepaalt welke projecten en centrale data-innovaties prioriteit krijgen. Team Performance & Coaching: Je geeft direct leiding aan een team van lokale analisten, coacht hen in hun rol als strategisch partner voor titels en bevordert de zelfredzaamheid van de redacties. Strategisch Filter: Je fungeert als de 'brug' en het filter voor ad-hoc vragen en distribueert deze efficiënt binnen het team om de focus op impact te bewaken. Analytisch Expert: Je voert zelfstandig complexe, zwaardere clusterbrede analyses en strategische deep-dives uit die specifiek voor het cluster zijn bedoeld. Netwerkfunctie: Je stemt clusteroverstijgende prioriteit

Je draait volledig mee op een deelredactie: je schrijft artikelen, helpt mee bij audiovisuele producties of doet ander werk binnen onze journalistieke organisatie. Deze vacature is bedoeld voor stageplekken van maart tot en met mei 2027. Stuur je sollicitatie voor deze periode uiterlijk woensdag 16 december 2026 in. De artikelen of producties hoeven niet daadwerkelijk gepubliceerd te zijn. Voeg deze artikelen integraal of via een url toe onderaan je motivatiebrief. jobs.title: Country Executive
jobs.description: Country Executive The Finance Function Is Broken. Everyone Building For It Is Boring. Fast-growing multi-entity companies get two options: duct-tape a Frankenstack, or surrender to a corporate ERP and its consultant army. Both are bad. Both are beatable. Beating them market by market is this job. Light is the AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, smarter every month. We call it organic software. Legora, Lovable and Fuse Energy run on it. Product ships something worth shouting about every single week. What we don’t have yet is someone who owns each market as their own. We’re hiring Country Executives across several markets. Tell us which one is yours. This Is Not A Country Manager Role. Most first-in-market hires get a quota, a deck and a flight. They repeat the London pitch in a local accent and forward complaints to HQ. This is the opposite. This is a founding hire for someone who wants far more scope than their years of experience would get them anywhere else. No local playbook. You’ll be the person who owns your market, and within a year you should know its complexity (its rules, its buyers, its excuses) better than anyone else. It’s not a leadership title. It’s the seed of one. Do this right and there’s a real path: stand up an entity, build the team around you, move into product, or run the region as GM. What You’ll Be Doing Sitting across from finance leaders. Real conversations, not discovery calls off a script. You find out what they actually need, the thing behind the thing they asked for, and you come back with it written down clearly enough for engineers to build against. Being the connective tissue. Customer, product, commercial. What you learn in-market changes how Light builds and how Light sells. You are the wire between them, and the wire has to carry current in both directions. jobs.title: FPGA Engineer Intern
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As an FPGA Engineer Intern on Harmattan AI’s compute module team, you will take camera aggregation from concept to real hardware for the first time. Our drones carry more cameras than a single processor can take in, and your job is to show how an FPGA can close that gap. You will own the work end to end, from first design to a demonstrator on the bench. Your results will set how cameras are connected in our next hardware generation. Responsibilities Integrate existing IP cores, write HDL wrappers, simulate and validate FPGA logic that merges multiple camera streams into one. Investigate the system’s limits in camera count, resolution and frame rate. Build the processor-side pipeline that splits the merged stream so each camera stays independently usable. Debug the full chain, from cables and connectors to FPGA logic and camera software on the processor. Deliver a complete demonstrator and documentation that guide our next hardware design. Candidate Requirements Final-year Master’s or engineering school student in electrical engineering, electronics or embedded systems. Previous hands-on experience with FPGAs and digital board design and debugging. Experience writing software that runs close to the hardware; embedded Linux is a plus. Ideally, previous exposure to video or camera interfaces. Hands-on in the lab and comfortable reworking wiring, connectors and test setups to get a system running.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Delta
jobs.description: P-1127 At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world s toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world s best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions. Our engineering teams build highly technical products that fulfill real, important needs in the world. We develop and operate one of the largest scale software platforms. The fleet consists of millions of virtual machines, generating terabytes of logs and processing exabytes of data per day. At our scale, we regularly observe cloud hardware, network, and operating system faults, and our software must gracefully shield our customers from any of the above. The Delta DML team owns the core write-path operations for Delta Lake, the open-source storage layer behind the Databricks Lakehouse. Our mission is to deliver industry-leading performance and a seamless user experience at massive scale, with most data written in Databricks flowing through our platform.  We drive performance innovations like Low Shuffle Merge and Deletion Vectors and actively contribute to open source efforts to unify Delta and Iceberg formats. jobs.description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS)
jobs.description: Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS) adalah badan resmi dan satu-satunya yang dibentuk oleh pemerintah berdasarkan Keputusan Presiden RI No. 8 Tahun 2001 yang memiliki tugas dan fungsi menghimpun dan menyalurkan zakat, infak, dan sedekah (ZIS) pada tingkat nasional. Berikut ini lowongan kerja Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS). Lahirnya Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2011 tentang Pengelolaan Zakat semakin mengukuhkan peran BAZNAS sebagai lembaga yang berwenang melakukan pengelolaan zakat secara nasional. Dalam UU tersebut, BAZNAS dinyatakan sebagai lembaga pemerintah nonstruktural yang bersifat mandiri dan bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden melalui Menteri Agama. Dalam mengelola zakat, BAZNAS menerapkan prinsip 3A, yakni Aman Syari, Aman Regulasi, dan Aman NKRI. Aman Syari artinya pengelolaan zakat yang dilaksanakan BAZNAS harus selaras dengan koridor hukum syari. Pengelolaan zakat harus selaras dan tidak boleh bertentangan dengan sumber hukum Islam, Al-Quran dan Sunnah. Aman Regulasi artinya bahwa pengelolaan zakat harus memperhatikan rambu-rambu peraturan hukum dan perundangan. Lowongan Kerja Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS) Saat ini Badan Amil Zakat Nasional memberikan kesempatan lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: 1. jobs.description: PT Reska Multi Usaha (KAI Services) merupakan salah satu anak perusahaan PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) yang berdiri sejak tahun 2003, mempunyai tujuan melaksanakan dan menunjang kebijakan dan program PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) selaku perusahaan induk khususnya usaha restoran kereta api serta usaha lainnya. Rekrutmen Training Staff PT Reska Multi Usaha (KAI Services) Bermula atas kesadaran pemerintahan Hindia Belanda menyediakan restoran Kereta Api sebagai pemenuhan akan makan dan minum sepanjang perjalanan maka dibentuklah restoran Kereta Api pada rentang waktu 1930 an. Hingga akhirnya di masa PJKA yang Pada awal berdirinya di tahun 1971 adalah merupakan salah satu unit di Balai Besar PJKA dengan nama RESTORKA yang berkantor di jalan Stasiun Timur No. 6 Bandung.
